layer1.goal: Retrieve, deliver, or restore entities in a household environment

subgoals.description: Place the requested object at its destination.
Return an articulated source to its closed state.
Obtain and hold the requested object.

deliver.description: Navigate to the destination and place the object; re-approach and retry with another Place skill on failure.
deliver.label: Deliver to table

deliver.description: Navigate to the destination and place the object; re-approach and retry with another Place skill on failure.
deliver.label: Deliver to counter

deliver.description: Navigate to and open the destination container, place the object inside, then re-approach and retry on failure.
deliver.label: Deliver into fridge

deliver.applicable_when: destination is inside a counter drawer
deliver.description: Navigate to and open the destination container, place the object inside, then re-approach and retry on failure.
deliver.label: Deliver into drawer

restore.applicable_when: the used source or destination is a fridge
restore.description: Navigate to and close the articulation; reposition and use a second Close skill if the first close fails.
restore.label: Restore fridge

restore.applicable_when: the used source or destination is a counter drawer
restore.description: Navigate to and close the articulation; reposition and use a second Close skill if the first close fails.
restore.label: Restore drawer

retrieve.applicable_when: object is exposed on a reachable surface
retrieve.description: Navigate directly to an exposed object and grasp it; relocalize and regrasp if the first grasp fails.
retrieve.label: Retrieve from open surface

retrieve.applicable_when: the object is stored in a fridge
retrieve.description: Navigate to and open the source, approach the object, and grasp it; relocalize and regrasp after a failed grasp.
retrieve.label: Retrieve from fridge

retrieve.applicable_when: the object is stored in a counter drawer
retrieve.description: Navigate to and open the source, approach the object, and grasp it; relocalize and regrasp after a failed grasp.
retrieve.label: Retrieve from drawer

subgoal_graph.goal: Retrieve, deliver, or restore entities in a household environment

subgoals.description: Place the requested object at its destination.
Return an articulated source to its closed state.
Obtain and hold the requested object.

contracts.description: Move to a pose from which the grounded goal is reachable.
contracts.name: navigate.all

contracts.description: Grasp and hold one grounded object.
contracts.name: pick.all

contracts.description: Place a held object at a grounded destination.
contracts.name: place.all

contracts.description: Open one grounded articulation such as a fridge or drawer.
contracts.name: open.all

contracts.description: Close one grounded articulation such as a fridge or drawer.
contracts.name: close.all

semantics.alternative_to: different semantic contexts that achieve the same SubGoal
semantics.execution_protocol: select one SemanticStrategy for an active SubGoal, project its execution view, then resolve its directed fallback chain
semantics.fallback_to: a failed primary SkillNode transitions to another recovery SkillNode
